goal: Codex and TSUZUNE development workflow major reform
success_criteria: Shared Task Contract and three execution lanes are canonical
Global AGENTS and core user Skills have non-overlapping responsibilities
All changed Skills pass validation and independent forward tests
TSUZUNE roadmap and execution record reflect the verified boundary
constraints: No plugin or system Skill changes
No new runtime, hook, database, daemon, or external dependency

integration_policy.conflict_resolution: Inspect current global AGENTS, Skill files, repository rules, and production TSUZUNE before choosing.
integration_policy.final_output: Validated Skill and contract changes plus a TSUZUNE execution record
